## Generate social media images from a plain brief with Gemini

### How it works
Most people write a lazy one-line prompt and get a mediocre image. This template fixes that with an art-director step. Describe what you need in the built-in form and pick a style, and a Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini rewrites your rough brief into a rich, detailed image prompt - composition, lighting, palette and mood. Google Gemini then generates the image from that prompt, the prompt is logged to a Google Sheet, and the finished image is emailed to you as an attachment. If generation fails, you get a friendly email instead of a broken run.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets and Gmail.
2. Point the Log Image node at your spreadsheet (tab: Images).
3. Open the form URL and describe an image.

### Customization tips
Save the image to Google Drive or post it to Slack, or generate several variations per brief.

## 1. Brief & art direction (Basic LLM Chain)
The form takes a rough brief and style; Gemini rewrites it into a detailed image prompt.

## 2. Generate the image
Gemini generates the image from the art-directed prompt. Failures email the requester.

## 3. Log & deliver
Log the prompt in Sheets and email the finished image as an attachment.
